data.case_title: Sports club membership fee reminder (Sportverein Beispielau)
data.title: Payment reminder: Sportverein Beispielau membership fee 2026
data.summary: Sportverein Beispielau 1911 e.V. writes that the direct debit for the 2026 family membership fee failed and asks Johanna Beispielacker to transfer the total of €172.50 (€168.00 annual fee plus €4.50 return-debit charge) by 3 December 2026. It also notes that the next automatic direct debit for a separate contract (DX-2411-496) is scheduled for 10 December 2026 at the unchanged amount.
data.explanation: The sports club tried to collect your 2026 family membership fee by direct debit, but your bank returned it, which added a €4.50 fee. You now need to transfer €172.50 yourself by the stated date. If your bank details have changed, you can instead send the club a new SEPA mandate so future debits work. Separately, the club mentions another contract of yours (DX-2411-496) that will be debited automatically on 10 December 2026 at the same amount as before — no action needed there unless you want to check the amount is correct. If you don't pay the outstanding amount, further reminder fees or exclusion from membership benefits could follow, though the letter does not specify exact consequences.

items.title: Pay the outstanding membership fee and return-debit charge

date.text: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag bis zum 03.12.2026 auf das Vereinskonto.

items.action: Transfer €172.50 to the club's bank account by the stated deadline.
items.consequence: If you don't pay, the club may charge further fees or restrict membership, though this is not spelled out in the letter.
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag bis zum 03.12.2026 auf das Vereinskonto.

items.title: Upcoming automatic direct debit for contract DX-2411-496

date.text: Die nächste Abbuchung per Lastschrift erfolgt automatisch am 10.12.2026, in unveränderter Höhe.

items.action: Make sure sufficient funds are in your account, as another contract's payment will be debited automatically at the same amount as before.
items.quote: Zu Ihrem weiteren Vertrag DX-2411-496: Die nächste Abbuchung per Lastschrift erfolgt automatisch am 10.12.2026, in unveränderter Höhe.

items.title: Send a new SEPA mandate if your bank details changed
items.action: If you changed your bank account, send the club a new SEPA mandate so future direct debits succeed.
items.consequence: Without a valid mandate, future direct debits may fail again and incur further return-debit fees.
items.quote: Hat sich Ihre Bankverbindung geändert, schicken Sie uns einfach ein neues SEPA-Mandat.
